deadline.value: Doctoral applications for Fall entry are due February 15, and the catalog says they are reviewed on a rolling basis.

also.quote: Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.

entry_route.value: The graduate school sets 72 hours for a PhD after a bachelor's and 42 after a master's, so both routes are open.
entry_route.quote: Students who do not hold a master’s degree will be required to complete a minimum of seventy-two hours of graduate credit

gre_general.value: The department says GRE scores are not required for its programs.

toefl_min.value: The department requires a TOEFL score of 79 for applicants whose native language is not English.
toefl_min.quote: For students whose native language is not English, a minimum score of 79 TOEFL

ielts_min.value: The department requires an IELTS score of 6.5 for applicants whose native language is not English.
ielts_min.quote: a minimum score of 6.5 IELTS is required for admission

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: The catalog does not say a supervisor must agree before admission.

funding.value: The catalog states no funding policy.

notes: Geological Engineering (PhD and DE) is a separate catalog program, not covered here; its page says GRE scores are not required. The department also accepts PTE 53 in place of TOEFL 79.
